title: Putnami Template Manifest
description: Standalone template manifest for project scaffolding.

name.description: Template identifier (e.g., typescript-library, go-server). Must be a scoped package name (@scope/name) or a simple kebab-case identifier.

extension.description: Extension to activate for projects created from this template.

workspaceDevDependencies.description: Dev dependencies to add to the workspace root when using this template.

testVariables.description: Variable overrides for template testing. Keys are variable names (e.g., projectName), values are the test values to use instead of defaults.
